storyCards.fact:
Blink-182's "Up All Night" reached #65 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Up All Night" is a song by American rock band Blink-182, released on July 14, 2011 as the lead single from the group's sixth studio album, Neighborhoods (2011).

The song peaked at #65 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 2 weeks on the chart.

Up All Night was released in 2011.
